title: Battle of Guayubín
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Guayubín", at revision 1370442248, opens: "The Battle of Guayubín was a battle of the Dominican Restoration War that took place on August 19, 1863. Dominican forces attacked Spanish cavalry and a marching column during its movement through the northwest, resulting in scattered skirmishes and a Spanish withdrawal toward Guayubín." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q134622298, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
